template: Open {{v1}} in the browser. If a login form is shown, sign in with username '{{v2}}' and password typed EXACTLY as the literal text {{v3}} (the environment substitutes the real password when that exact text is typed into the field - do not write anything else, do not try to resolve it yourself). After you are signed in, go to the Assets list and find every asset whose NAME starts with 'Seed:'. For each such asset report its name and its asset tag exactly as displayed. Do not create or modify anything.
